claim: The one-click demo uses realistic sample cards, resets, and never changes real practice data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; /demo; seed a sentinel in the real database; edit and reset demo; start for real; assert sentinel unchanged and demo database removed

claim: Today shows at most three practice cards.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; assert three queue records, 3/3 state, disabled add action, and boundary guidance

claim: Card edits are stored locally and survive reload.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; edit an action; reload; assert the changed action remains

claim: A running practice timer survives reload.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; start timer; wait; reload; assert running state and elapsed time

claim: An attempt records its outcome, evidence, and optional follow-up action.
where: How it works, attempt dialog, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; finish a card with outcome, evidence, and follow-up; assert follow-up in Today and evidence in Archive

claim: A card can keep an optional local photo and HTTP(S) link to the user's score reference.
where: card form, What it does not do, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; attach a small image and HTTPS link; reload; assert both remain on the card

claim: The free archive shows the latest 30 records while retaining older records.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample with 32 completed records; assert 30 visible, 2 retained, and no free search field

claim: A valid $9 one-time Supporter license shows the full archive and adds search; no checkout link is offered before registration.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; assert pending checkout has no link; use a recorded valid Sociobot verification response; assert price copy, 32 visible records, and working search

claim: JSON export includes every card in the workspace.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; download backup; parse JSON; assert version and all 35 sample records

claim: JSON import replaces the selected workspace after confirmation.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; import a valid one-card backup; confirm replacement; assert only imported card appears

claim: Erase clears every card in the selected local workspace.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; confirm erase; assert zero cards; reset; assert sample records return

claim: Practice cards work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: own fresh browser context; /demo sample; wait for service-worker control; set context offline; reload; assert sample card and offline state

claim: Practice content stays in the browser with no analytics, tracking, remote fonts, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; record all requests through edit and timer actions; assert only same-origin requests and only the demo IndexedDB namespace

claim: The interface fits a 390 px phone and keeps controls at least 44 px.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample at 390 by 844; assert no horizontal overflow and measure every visible button, link, and summary

claim: License verification contacts the Sociobot billing API only after the user provides a license.
sandbox: fresh /demo settings; intercept the documented billing origin; assert no request before input and exactly one verification request after explicit submit

claim: The main practice flow works with a keyboard.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; use Tab, Enter, Escape, and Space; assert skip focus, dialog focus return, and timer state

claim: Light and dark themes pass serious accessibility checks, and reduced-motion removes movement.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample in light and dark reduced-motion media; run axe; assert no serious or critical findings and near-zero transition duration
